description: Composite subsidy diagnosis v1: runs the work24 사업주 사전진단 sweep (one step covering every gated 지원사업) plus opendata nts.status, then reports which 지원금 the workplace may apply for. The work24 leg replays a logged-in session. No account_link_id is needed here: each step finds its own institution link. Verdicts keep work24's four raw states: 조사후결정/오류 are reported as undetermined, never folded into eligible the way the work24 screen does. If computed is null the result could not be assembled: read computed_error for the reason and do not present the result as complete. Two shapes carry that case: this envelope with partial set to true (we fetched everything - the legs hold it - but could not calculate), or an error whose data carries the same envelope. partial is true whenever the result is incomplete, whether a leg failed or the calculation did. Files: a document generated from this result, as PDF only when requested in output_formats, listed in artifacts[] of the result with a download_url that works for 15 minutes; each file is kept for 7 days. If a link has expired, call xdata__job__result with the pack_run_id from the result for fresh links. For an anonymous result, keep its private recovery_receipt and send it with the original job_id or pack_run_id to xdata__job__result. It grants access to that result only, until the original file retention expires. Do not publish it. Losing it cannot be repaired by signing up. The receipt also works if the client later signs in; it does not grant access to other results. Without a receipt, results require the original account and lane. 호출마다 토큰 1소진 요청 처리 시 XBOSS 작업을 생성하고 처리 결과를 저장합니다. 기관 원본의 조회 여부와 별개로 이 호출은 순수 읽기 전용이 아닙니다. 기관 데이터 변경은 도구별 실행 내용과 기존 확인 절차를 따릅니다.

business_management_no.description: 고용보험 사업장관리번호. Omit to use the number stored at login; supply it when the company has more than one workplace.

idempotency_key.description: Optional outer idempotency key; leg keys are derived deterministically from this value.

notice_field.description: 공고 지원 분야(선택). 금융, 기술, 인력, 수출, 내수, 창업, 경영, 기타 가운데 하나. 비우면 전 분야의 공고를 함께 봅니다.

notice_hashtags.description: 공고 해시태그(선택). 지역이나 업종 같은 낱말 목록이며 하나라도 맞는 공고를 고릅니다(예: 서울, 제조업). 낱말 안에 공백은 넣지 않습니다.

output_formats.description: Optional. Also return this result as a file (PDF) in artifacts[] of the result. Omit it for data only.

programme_keys.description: Optional subset of catalogue programme keys; omit to diagnose every 사전진단 사업.
